string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: New cross-shaped home screen: Continue, Watch, Listen, Play and Apps in one row. ◀ ▶ changes group, ▲ ▼ picks inside it, and the chosen item shows large where they cross
Each group remembers its last item. The screen opens on Watch › TV; HOME goes back to Watch and, pressed again, to TV
Apps shows your 8 most used apps and, at the end, “All apps” with the full grid to see, move and hide them
Home screen icons in three styles: Object, Symbol or Duotone (Settings › Home screen)
Top bar in four ways (Settings › Home screen): Steps back (only time and weather; ▲ brings profile, search and voice), Light (no capsules), Big clock in the bottom corner, or the old Capsules
Art of the item in focus behind the cross, on the right: the scene of the last movie or series, the app banner, the group color. It can be turned off
Holding OK on an app on the home screen opens its options (hide or uninstall)

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: When you press HOME, does the new screen open on Watch with TV highlighted?
Does ◀ ▶ change group and ▲ ▼ pick inside it, and does the group remember its last item when you come back?
From another group, does HOME go back to Watch, and pressing HOME again go to TV?
Does Apps show the most used apps and, at the end, does “All apps” open the full grid?
Holding OK on an app in Apps, do the Hide and Uninstall options appear?
In Settings › Home screen, does switching between Object, Symbol and Duotone change the cross icons?
Is moving around the cross with the arrows smooth, without stutters or skipped frames?
With the cross in focus, only time and weather show at the top; pressing ▲ on the first item brings the whole bar and ▼ returns?
While moving in the cross, the art on the right follows the item (series scene, app banner)?
